entries.title: See your devices around home
entries.body: Settings → Devices shows which computers and phones are connected to your home computer, connecting, or out of reach. A connected device can show that work is not ready, and setup progress appears without changing its connection state. Select a device for its details and actions, or switch to a list without losing your selection.

picture.alt: The Devices map with eight paired devices around the cyan home computer and a connection legend underneath
